name: What steps are involved during a complete interior room or basement remodel?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved during a complete interior room or basement remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contractors start with comprehensive containment, using heavy plastic barriers, floor protection, and dust-control protocols before beginning demolition. Hazardous conditions, such as old pipe leaks, framing rot, or hidden structural damage, are addressed first to establish a sound foundation. The team then executes custom framing, coordinates rough-in plumbing and electrical inspections, hangs and finishes drywall, and applies precision tile, marble, and interior paint. A final walk-through ensures every piece of molding, hardware, and finish trim meets exact specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes site protection, demolition, framing, rough trade coordination, drywall, tile, custom trim, painting, and a final inspection walk-through.
